question: Ajit Pawar, who will take oath as the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra on July 2, 2023, belongs to which political party?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ajit Pawar** is a prominent leader of the **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)**.
 
• He will take oath as the **Deputy Chief Minister** of Maharashtra on **July 2, 2023**.
 
• The **NCP** is a major political party in the state of Maharashtra.
